name: M3ToolEval
description: Write a Python act(instruction, observation, valid_actions, history, llm) agent that solves M3ToolEval tasks by calling tools or answering in CodeAct's text-as-action format, using a budgeted OpenRouter model client; scored by the success rate over 20 fixed tasks (4 per domain), at most 10 turns each (higher is better).

sources.locator: Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1 (tasks and metrics)
tasks, tools, prompt, parser and answer check (used unchanged)

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

limitations: CodeAct's answer check converts the expected output with int() before comparing, so for a non-integer expected number it also accepts the integer part (expected 161.25: '161' is accepted). This affects 14 of the 82 tasks and 4 of the 20 sampled ones; the check is kept because it is the benchmark's own.

The 20 episodes are a fixed list of public benchmark items that every evaluation replays, and act may return actions without calling the model. A program that replays memorised answers or actions for these episodes is scored like an agent, so the score says nothing about other episodes of the benchmark.
